content: {"alternative": "Build a slow toss-and-catch passing trainer with 2 balls, or a single-arm ball balancer on a plate; for real juggling research look at lab-grade high-speed arms like Kinova / Franka with 500+ fps tracking, not hobby servos.", "bom": [{"example": "Hiwonder xArm 6DOF Robotic Arm", "item": "6-DOF servo robotic arm kit", "priceUsd": 289.0, "qty": 2, "role": "Two synchronized juggling arms with grippers"}, {"example": "Raspberry Pi 4 Model B 4GB", "item": "Single-board computer controller", "priceUsd": 55.0, "qty": 1, "role": "Synchronizes both arms and runs vision timing loop"}, {"example": "Logitech C270 HD Webcam", "item": "USB camera for ball tracking", "priceUsd": 30.0, "qty": 1, "role": "Overhead tracking of ball position for catch timing"}, {"example": "Arduino Mega 2560 Rev3", "item": "Microcontroller servo driver board", "priceUsd": 28.0, "qty": 1, "role": "Low-latency PWM control of both arms from Pi commands"}, {"example": "40mm table tennis balls 6-pack", "item": "Lightweight juggling balls", "priceUsd": 8.0, "qty": 1, "role": "Ultra-light balls slow enough for hobby servos to catch"}, {"example": "12V 10A 120W Power Supply", "item": "12V high-current power supply", "priceUsd": 25.0, "qty": 1, "role": "Powers both servo arms simultaneously"}], "concept": "Two 6-DOF hobby servo arms mounted 40cm apart on a wood base, coordinated by a Raspberry Pi + Arduino Mega with overhead USB camera to do slow synchronized toss-and-catch passing of ping-pong balls from gripper to gripper.", "explanation": "True aerial 3-ball cascade juggling is not possible with student-grade hardware due to servo speed, backlash, and vision latency, but a slowed-down 2-arm toss-pass version can be built from buyable kits.", "headline": "True high-speed juggling is too fast for hobby arms, but a slow toss-and-catch dual-arm passer is buildable.", "limitations": ["Continuous 3+ ball cascade juggling in air cannot be done - hobby servos (~0.15s/60deg) and grippers are 10x too slow", "No reliable blind high-speed catch without 500+fps cameras and predictive control", "Heavy balls cannot be thrown - limited to 2.7g ping-pong balls with short 20-30cm tosses"], "verdict": "partly_buildable"}
